name: test
config_yaml:
text:
  ocr:
    engine: paddleocr
    languages:
    - ch
    - en
    confidence_threshold: 0.5
  encoding:
    chinese_model: hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext
    english_model: sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2
    embedding_dim: 768
    max_length: 512
    batch_size: 4
image:
  components:
    perceptual_hash:
      enabled: true
      algorithm: dHash
      hash_size: 16
    deep_features:
      enabled: false
      model: efficientnet_b4
      output_dim: 512
  batch_size: 4
index:
  type: IVFFlat
  nlist: 100
  nprobe: 10
name: balanced
description: Balanced configuration with moderate thresholds (precision/recall trade-off)
matching:
  exact_match:
    enabled: true
    criteria:
      perceptual_hash:
        max_distance: 5
  content_match:
    enabled: true
    stage1:
      text_similarity_threshold: 0.75
      top_k: 100
    optional_conditions:
      visual_similarity:
        enabled: true
        weight: 0.05
    scoring:
      method: weighted_sum
      threshold: 0.85
  output:
    top_k: 10
    grouping:
      by_match_type: true
    include_details:
      feature_scores: true
      debug_info: false
